pr.title: fix(task-orchestrator): repair bridge-backed ConPort persistence wiring
pr.body:
## Summary
- inject configured DopeconBridge bearer token into Task Orchestrator
- pin Task Orchestrator and bridge REST callers to ConPort port 3004
- add static/synthetic contracts; no live writes

## Validation
- targeted pytest contracts
- `docker compose -f compose.yml config --no-interpolate`
- packet schema and diff checks

## Gates
- Embedded audit and PR Steward status recorded truthfully; no claim of live JWT or container validation.

steps.task: Trace canonical compose, WorkflowStore, shared DopeconBridge client, bridge authentication, ConPort REST launch, and custom-data upsert semantics.
requirements: Record observed facts separately from unknown live state.
Do not call live services or persist data.
validation: Research identifies the actual authenticated bridge path, REST port, and existing upsert key.

steps.task: Wire the configured bearer token into Task Orchestrator, route REST clients to ConPort port 3004, and enforce repeat epic-create idempotency through the existing custom-data key.
requirements: Token expression must contain no value or unsafe default.
Keep authenticated bridge boundary and existing WorkflowStore client.
A repeated epic idempotency key must return the original immutable request; a conflicting payload must fail closed.
validation: Static test proves token injection and REST-port wiring.
Synthetic test proves bridge client sends configured bearer token and workflow custom-data upsert path remains stable.

steps.task: Run narrow tests, compose syntax, schema, diff, code review, precommit, embedded-audit route, and PR Steward intake; create a draft PR only when needed gates remain unavailable.
requirements: Record PASS, FAIL, and NOT_RUN without claiming live proof.
Stop for audit or review gate failure.
validation: All local validation exit codes recorded.
Embedded audit, PR Steward, and supervisor-review states are recorded with exact blockers.
